title: SEC reportedly investigating Nvidia amid Huang exit
text: The SEC is opening a probe into Nvidia following the departure of CEO Jensen Huang, who admitted to an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, reports The Wall Street Journal.

title: Google joins the tech outage trend by announcing it’s not having one
text: With tech outages seemingly everywhere, Google took the unusual step of announcing that Gmail is working just fine, actually.

title: Model ML raises $250M to automate investment banking grunt work
text: The startup says its agents understand the full context of deals that bankers and consultants are working on and can automatically update financial models and presentations when new developments affect their analysis.

title: Google expands access to Gemini Tasks, which can help with calls, purchases
text: Gemini's Task mode can help users coordinate calls, log into websites, and even make purchases on the user's behalf.

title: Google to keep Gemini chats for 2 months, up from 72 hours, even with history off
text: Google's Gemini update extending chat retention will roll out globally over the coming weeks.

title: As decision model use skyrockets, is customization the next frontier?
text: Sqwish Labs has a new wrinkle on the decision model: Train it with your own data to max its capabilities.

title: Pedestal AI raises $4.7 million to agentify the supply chain
text: The company uses agentic AI to make supply chains faster and more reliable.

title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
text: Introducing GPT‑6.2 Astra and Sol, with better professional outputs, coding, computer use, and efficiency at lower cost across ChatGPT Work, Codex, and the API.

title: Proton’s Lumo, a privacy-focused alternative to ChatGPT and Claude, arrives on desktop
text: Proton's new Lumo Desktop app for Windows, Mac, and Linux lets users automate tasks across files and connected apps, with granular controls over what its AI can access.

title: AI models can be tricked into identifying civilians as military targets by telling them it’s a game
text: Vals, a San Francisco-based AI evaluation startup, tested whether leading AI models could be manipulated into participating in autonomous warfare. They usually compiled.

title: Put Gemini to work for you
text: Tasks in Gemini is now free of charge in six countries, with new features starting in the U.S. and deeper Google Workspace integration to get things done on your behalf.

title: Jensen Huang says he would be ‘honored’ if allowed to return as Nvidia CEO
text: In the first public statement since his resignation, Nvidia founder Jensen Huang signaled his willingness to return as CEO.

title: Daydream’s new AI agent acts as your personal stylist — and can shop for you, too
text: Daydream's new AI shopping agent can remember your style, virtually try on clothes, plan outfits around your wardrobe, track sales, and complete purchases.

title: Voyage Labs raises $12 million for a specialized AI travel assistant
text: Voyage Labs’ flagship product is called Atlas, meant to work as a personal assistant for your trip-planning, available today in private beta.

title: Isomorphic Labs raises $5B as it looks to take drug candidates to clinical trials
text: Isomorphic Labs, the AI drug-discovery platform that was spun out of Google’s DeepMind in 2021, has raised $5 billion in a Series C funding round.

title: Science Corporation’s brain tech is worth $3.5 billion after new funding
text: Science Corp. raised a $400 million Series D to scale up its anti-blindness business.

title: Nvidia’s first big move after Jensen Huang’s exit targets national security
text: The new standing committee will give board-level oversight of national security policies, export control compliance, and global trade risks, the company said.

title: Spotify’s new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists
text: The update comes as Billboard reported last month that Sony Music had requested the removal of more than 260,000 deepfake songs from digital platforms, nearly double the number the label disclosed in March.
